It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.
It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.
It meditates to heighten its inner energy and to float in the air. It eats one berry a day.

pokemon.name: 恰雷姆
descriptions: Through the power of meditation, Medicham developed its sixth sense. It gained the ability to use psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon is known to meditate for a whole month without eating.
It is said that through meditation, Medicham heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This Pokémon hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.
Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe’s next move.
It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.
It gains the ability to see the aura of its opponents by honing its mind through starvation.

pokemon.name: 落雷兽
descriptions: 会在体毛中储存静电。 在空气干燥的季节 会从全身散发出火花。
会将静电储存在体毛中进行放电。 暴风雨临近时，会从全身散发出火花。
长长的体毛， 通过摩擦在全身储存静电。 是以速度为傲的宝可梦。
通过空气与体毛的摩擦产生静电。 落雷兽如果奔跑， 会发出噼里啪啦的声音。

pokemon.name: 雷电兽
descriptions: 极少出现在人前。 据说它的住所就在雷电落下的地方。
用电刺激肌肉，所以能迅速行动。 用电也能缓解肌肉疼痛， 因此很快会治愈。
在不自然的雷云之下有着雷电兽。 听说会用和雷同等的速度奔驰。

pokemon.name: 正电拍拍
descriptions: When Plusle is cheering on its partner, it flashes with electric sparks from all over its body. If its partner loses, this Pokémon cries loudly.
Plusle always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this Pokémon shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.
It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.
It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.
It cheers on partners while scattering sparks from its body. It climbs telephone poles to absorb electricity.

pokemon.name: 負电拍拍
descriptions: Minun loves to cheer on its partner in battle. It gives off sparks from its body while it is doing so. If its partner is in trouble, this Pokémon gives off increasing amounts of sparks.
Minun is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.
It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.
Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.
Its dislike of water makes it take shelter under the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms made of sparks for cheering.

pokemon.name: 电萤虫
descriptions: Volbeat’s tail glows like a lightbulb. With other Volbeat, it uses its tail to draw geometric shapes in the night sky. This Pokémon loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

With the arrival of night, Volbeat emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This Pokémon is attracted by the sweet aroma of Illumise.
It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.
It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves Illumise’s sweet aroma.
It emits light from its tail to communicate. It loves the sweet aroma given off by ILLUMISE.

pokemon.name: 甜甜萤
descriptions: Illumise leads a flight of illuminated Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. This Pokémon is said to earn greater respect from its peers by composing more complex designs in the sky.
Illumise attracts a swarm of Volbeat using a sweet fragrance. Once the Volbeat have gathered, this Pokémon leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.
With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw signs with light in the night sky.
Its fragrance attracts a swarm of Volbeat, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.
It guides VOLBEAT to draw signs in night skies. There are scientists that study the patterns it creates.

pokemon.name: 毒蔷薇
descriptions: 会用右手和左手分别放出 ２种不同的毒来进行攻击。 香气越浓越有精神。
只要闻到它的花香， 就能放松心情。浓郁的香味 是毒蔷薇有活力的证明。

pokemon.name: 溶食兽
descriptions: Most of Gulpin’s body is made up of its stomach—its heart and brain are very small in comparison. This Pokémon’s stomach contains special enzymes that dissolve anything.
Virtually all of Gulpin’s body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This Pokémon’s stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.
There is nothing its stomach can’t digest. While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.
It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach comprises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.
Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.

pokemon.name: 吞食兽
descriptions: Swalot has no teeth, so what it eats, it swallows whole, no matter what. Its cavernous mouth yawns widely. An automobile tire could easily fit inside this Pokémon’s mouth.
When Swalot spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this Pokémon gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.
It gulps anything that fits in its mouth. Its special enzymes can dissolve anything.
It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.
It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.

pokemon.name: 利牙鱼
descriptions: 拥有锋利的牙齿和 结实的下颚。水手们绝不会 主动靠近利牙鱼的栖息地。
即使发现猎物也不会单独 发起攻击。会等待伙伴的 到来，发动集体攻击。
结实的颚部和牙齿，如果是 木头造的船，轻易就可以咬碎。 围绕食物的问题，和野蛮鲈鱼争斗。
非常胆小，１只的话不会去狩猎。 如果聚集了５只左右的话， 就会一下子变得很粗暴。
即使一丝丝血的味道也能闻到， 并以集群形式袭击猎物。 但只有１只的话，就相当胆小。

pokemon.name: 巨牙鲨
descriptions: 被称为大海恶霸。 进入它栖息海域的船只 会无一例外地遭到袭击。
嗅到猎物的味道后， 会从臀部喷射海水， 以１２０公里的时速发动袭击。
会从臀部的孔里喷出 喝入的海水来游泳。 对血的气味十分敏感。
人们相信，如果带着它脱落的牙齿 就不会在海上遭遇事故， 因此会将牙齿加工为饰品等。
过去，它的背鳍被当做贵重的食材， 因此有着被滥捕的悲惨历史。

pokemon.name: 吼吼鲸
descriptions: 喝入大量的海水之后， 身体会鼓成像球一样。 每天要吃掉１吨的食物。
把喝入的海水从眼睛上方的 鼻孔中喷出来吸引他人。 每天要吃１吨弱丁鱼。
在极其偶然的情况下它们会群体 冲上沙滩，据说这是源自它们 远古时代居住在陆地时的习性。
会张着嘴游泳， 将食物连同海水一起吃下去。 不要的水会从鼻子里喷出来舍弃。
喜欢吓人。 喝入海水鼓成球一样， 弹跳着玩。

pokemon.name: 吼鲸王
descriptions: 总之，因为超级巨大而受欢迎。 观看吼鲸王在各地都是 非常受欢迎的游览项目。
有时会让大大的身体在波浪上跳跃， 并以此来产生冲击让对手昏迷。
小小的吼吼鲸如果被 巨牙鲨和破破舵轮袭击的话， 群体伙伴就会团结一致来守护。
因为会吃太多的鱼宝可梦， 所以数量增加过多的话，会被渔夫们驱赶。
有成群结队追逐猎物的习性。 用大大的嘴巴将弱丁鱼群 一口气尽数吞下。

pokemon.name: 呆火驼
descriptions: Numel stores magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit within its body. If it gets wet, the magma cools and hardens. In that event, the Pokémon’s body grows heavy and its movements become sluggish.
Numel is extremely dull witted—it doesn’t notice being hit. However, it can’t stand hunger for even a second. This Pokémon’s body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.
The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.
Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.
The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees F. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

pokemon.name: 喷火驼
descriptions: The humps on Camerupt’s back are formed by a transformation of its bones. They sometimes blast out molten magma. This Pokémon apparently erupts often when it is enraged.
Camerupt has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this Pokémon’s back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.
If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.
The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years--or whenever it becomes really angry.
It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.

pokemon.name: 煤炭龟
descriptions: 在弃用的煤矿中 住着很多煤炭龟， 它们会不停地挖掘煤炭。
会在甲壳中燃烧煤炭产生能量。 危急关头会喷出黑色的煤烟。
燃烧煤炭，制作能量。 如果煤炭烧尽， 身体就会变得无法动弹。
通过甲壳里喷出的烟 就能了解它的身体状况。 势头很旺时，说明很有精神。
如果甲壳中的火焰消失就会死亡。 要在家里培育的话，必须常备燃料。

pokemon.name: 跳跳猪
descriptions: Spoink keeps a pearl on top of its head. The pearl functions to amplify this Pokémon’s psychokinetic powers. It is therefore on a constant search for a bigger pearl.
Spoink bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this Pokémon cannot afford to stop bouncing—if it stops, its heart will stop.
It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.
It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.
Using its tail like a spring, it keeps its heart beating by bouncing constantly. If it stops, it dies.

pokemon.name: 噗噗猪
descriptions: Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to wield its fantastic powers. When it is doing so, it dances bizarrely. This Pokémon’s black pearls are valuable as works of art.
Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this Pokémon uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.
It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.
It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes’ minds.
It uses black pearls to amplify its psycho-power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

pokemon.name: 晃晃斑
descriptions: 每一只身上的斑点花纹都不同。 会用晃晃悠悠的动作 绝妙地躲避对手的攻击。
晃晃悠悠，步伐不稳健。 如果长时间连续行走， 就会变得状态很差。
每一只身上的斑点花纹都不同。 听说也有爱好者以这细微的 斑点位置的不同为乐。
晃晃悠悠，步伐不稳健， 但晃晃斑自己是打算要 笔直走路的哦。

pokemon.name: 大颚蚁
descriptions: 建造了绝对无法逃脱的 捣蒜钵状巢穴，并在巢穴里 等着猎物自己掉进来。
它在沙漠中建造的巢穴 造型就像是研钵一样。 一旦掉进去就再也逃不出来了。
制造兼有陷阱功能的巢穴， 一心一意埋伏着等待猎物。 到了晚上就潜回沙中睡觉。
颚部连岩石也能弄碎，但很重， 如果翻身了，就会爬不起来。 黑眼鳄会趁这个空当袭击它。
一边用大大的颚把挡道的 岩石咬碎，一边挖沙子。 巢穴的形状是捣蒜钵那样的。

pokemon.name: 超音波幼虫
descriptions: 为了让翅膀成长， 每天要用消化液溶化 并吸食大量的猎物。
２根翅膀高速振动产生的 超音波会引起剧烈的头痛。
会振动翅膀，产生特殊的音波。 呆在一起的训练家 有必要准备好耳塞。
振动翅膀，发出超音波。 会把晕厥的猎物 活埋在沙子里保存。
为了让翅膀成长， 每天要吸食大量 用消化液溶化的猎物。

pokemon.name: 沙漠蜻蜓
descriptions: 由于它挥动翅膀的声音 好似女性优美的歌声， 因此被称为沙漠精灵。
因为位于自己卷起的沙暴中心， 所以是很少现身于人前的宝可梦。
由于会被美丽歌声般的 振翅声夺走心神， 因此沙漠中不断有人遇难。
挥动翅膀卷起沙暴， 让流氓鳄潜伏在那里。 捉到的猎物会一起分享。
挥动翅膀的声音简直就是歌声。 凡是被这声音迷惑的， 最终会被卷入沙暴成为沙漠蜻蜓的食物。

pokemon.name: 刺球仙人掌
descriptions: The more arid and harsh the environment, the more pretty and fragrant a flower Cacnea grows. This Pokémon battles by wildly swinging its thorny arms.

Cacnea lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this Pokémon shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.
It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.
It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.
By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.

pokemon.name: 梦歌仙人掌
descriptions: If a traveler is going through a desert in the thick of night, Cacturne will follow in a ragtag group. The Pokémon are biding their time, waiting for the traveler to tire and become incapable of moving.
During the daytime, Cacturne remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This Pokémon becomes active at night when the temperature drops.
Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.
It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.
It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night when it hunts for prey exhausted from the desert’s heat.

pokemon.name: 青绵鸟
descriptions: 看起来像是一团棉花云，因此 不易被敌人发现。据说翅膀是 随着世代演进逐渐变白的。
像丝绵一样的翅膀中含有 空气，触感蓬松。绝不会 忽视对翅膀精细地保养。

pokemon.name: 七夕青鸟
descriptions: 虽然性情温顺，但如果被惹怒， 就会用尖锐的叫声威吓对方， 并且毫不留情地发动进攻。
一边舒适地在天空中飞翔， 一边发出优美的哼唱， 让听到之人都为之沉醉。

pokemon.name: 猫鼬斩
descriptions: Zangoose usually stays on all fours, but when angered, it gets up on its hind legs and extends its claws. This Pokémon shares a bitter rivalry with Seviper that dates back over generations.
Memories of battling its archrival Seviper are etched into every cell of Zangoose’s body. This Pokémon adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.
Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a Seviper nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.
It’s Seviper’s archrival. To threaten those it encounters, it fans out the claws on its front paws.
It has feuded with Seviper for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.

pokemon.name: 饭匙蛇
descriptions: Seviper’s swordlike tail serves two purposes—it slashes foes and douses them with secreted poison. This Pokémon will not give up its long-running blood feud with Zangoose.
Seviper shares a generations-long feud with Zangoose. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This Pokémon attacks using its sword-edged tail.
Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp. It’s Zangoose’s archrival.
In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.
For many generations, it has feuded with Zangoose. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.

pokemon.name: 月石
descriptions: 第一次发现它是在 ４０年前陨石坠落的地方。 只要注视敌人就能使其入睡。
月亮的盈缺似乎会 影响它力量的增减。 每到满月之夜就会变得活跃。

pokemon.name: 太阳岩
descriptions: 太阳能量是其力量之源， 所以白天会很强。 旋转时身体会发光。
当它旋转自己的身体时， 会发出太阳般的光芒， 让敌人的眼睛暂时失明。

pokemon.name: 泥泥鳅
descriptions: 会用２根长长的胡须 探索浑浊的河底。 用湿滑的粘膜保护着身体。
身体滑溜溜的很难抓住。 某个地区流传着泥泥鳅 是由泥土凝结而成的说法。
胡子上布满神经。 能像人类的鼻子和舌头那样 感知气味和味道。
滑溜溜的身体很难抓牢。 甚至因此诞生了比试 徒手捕捉量的节日。
２根胡子是灵敏的雷达。 即使在泥泞浑浊的水中， 也能侦查到猎物的位置。

pokemon.name: 鲶鱼王
descriptions: 会将大沼泽划为自己的领地。 如果有敌人接近的话，它就会狂暴起来， 并引发大地震。
会在沼泽底部筑巢。 只要是活物就来者不拒， 是什么都吃的大胃王。
它的视力不太好。 会通过胡子来感知水的振动， 掌握猎物的位置。
猛烈地摇晃地面，威吓对手。 会将沼泽底部的猎物连同泥巴 一起整个吞下。
成群的鲶鱼王在水面上跳跃的景象 被认为是地震的前兆。

pokemon.name: 龙虾小兵
descriptions: 来自于外国的宝可梦， 现在已经回归了野生环境。 不管多么污浊的河水都能适应。
有着顽强生命力的宝可梦。 不管河里的水有多脏， 它都能适应并在那里繁衍生息。
对环境的适应力非常强。 呆在浑浊臭水沟里的 大概就是丑丑鱼和这家伙。
被没有坚持培育的训练家放生了的 个体在增加，即使在阿罗拉也变得 时常能见到了。

pokemon.name: 铁螯龙虾
descriptions: 有着热爱战斗的性格。 当遇到靠近自己领地的对手， 会毫不留情地将之打倒。
不停挥舞自己巨大的钳子， 是个性格粗暴的家伙。 被认为是很难培育的宝可梦。
钳子经常会掉。钳子里面 跟好胜蟹和铁臂枪虾不同， 有臭泥味，实在很难吃。
性格暴躁，喜欢打架， 但如果钳子掉落，就会一下子弱下来。 在再生之前，都会提心吊胆的。

pokemon.name: 天秤偶
descriptions: 在古代遗迹被发现。 会一边旋转一边移动。 晚上睡觉的时候也是单脚站着。
会用单脚旋转着移动。 也能看到颠倒过来旋转的天秤偶。
如果发现了伙伴， 就会吵吵闹闹地叫唤着聚集。 会大量出现在古代的墓地里。
在原始人所居住的洞穴墙壁上， 描绘着像是天秤偶的宝可梦的样子。

pokemon.name: 念力土偶
descriptions: 似乎是从古代人做的 泥偶诞生而来的宝可梦。 能靠念力浮在空中移动。
似乎是由２万年前的 古代人制作的泥偶 蜕变而来的谜之宝可梦。
好像是古代人模仿 从天而降的某物制作而成。 会从双臂发射出光束。
如果淋湿，身体就会溶解掉。 所以下雨时会用精神力量 包住全身，保护自己。

pokemon.name: 触手百合
descriptions: 会吸附在海底岩石上， 用花瓣一样的触手 缠住接近自己的猎物。
从化石复原而来的宝可梦。 曾经生活在大约１亿年 以前温暖的大海里。
用强力的吸盘扒在岩石上， 因此无论怎样的惊涛骇浪 也不会被冲走。
曾生活在古代温暖的海里。 伪装成海草，埋伏着等待猎物， 等对方靠近的时候一口吞下。

pokemon.name: 摇篮百合
descriptions: 用触手将猎物缠住后， 会用消化液将其溶化， 然后吸收其中的养分。
虽然脚很短走得慢， 但脖子和触手能伸长３倍， 因此能捉到远处的猎物。
古代海里的食肉宝可梦。 能用８根触手捕捉猎物， 一边用消化液溶化一边吃。
平常栖息在海的浅滩底部， 退潮的时候就爬到陆地上， 四处寻找猎物。

pokemon.name: 太古羽虫
descriptions: 会把８根翅膀当做船桨划水， 并且游泳的速度相当快。 是虫宝可梦的一种祖先。
从化石复原而来的宝可梦。 曾经生活在大约１亿年前的 大海，用２只爪子捕捉猎物。
古代虫宝可梦中的一种。 好像会使用８根翅膀游泳， 速度意外的快。
从化石复原而来的太古羽虫 即使放到海里，也不会有精神。 因为现在的水质已和当时不同了。

pokemon.name: 太古盔甲
descriptions: 栖息在陆地，但也擅长游泳。 会潜入大海寻找猎物， 用锋利的爪子给予致命一击。
从海里变成了在陆地生活。 据了解，是一部分虫宝可梦的祖先。
生活在陆地上，曾为了 寻找猎物而出发去海里狩猎。 锐利的爪子是它最大的武器。
进化之后登上了陆地。 下半身得到了强化， 尾巴的攻击破坏力极强。

pokemon.name: 丑丑鱼
descriptions: 虽然外表丑陋， 但拥有顽强的生命力， 只要少量的水就能存活。
外表丑陋，所以不受欢迎。 拥有惊人的生命力， 因而成为了研究对象。
因为长得寒碜， 大多数人看都不看， 但是有只收集丑丑鱼的收藏家。
因为破破烂烂的，谁也不要捉。 因为看起来不好吃，也不会被当做猎物。 结果就是，数量嗖嗖地增加起来。
即使在脏水里也完全不介意的 强壮的宝可梦。但破破烂烂一副 寒酸的样子，所以不受欢迎。

pokemon.name: 美纳斯
descriptions: 据说目睹了美纳斯美丽 身姿的人，心中一切的 愤恨都能得到抚慰。
也被称为最美的宝可梦， 一直给予许多艺术家灵感。
栖息在很大的湖底。 听说，只要看见它那美丽的样子， 心里的污秽就会被清除。
被称为最美的宝可梦， 对于因喜爱丑丑鱼而培育它的 训练家，好像很微妙。
栖息在清澈的湖底。 在发生战争时出现， 治愈人们的心。

pokemon.name: 飘浮泡泡
descriptions: 样子会根据天气发生变化。 天气越恶劣， 性格也会变得越暴躁。
样子会根据天气发生变化。 但这是根据化学反应的结果， 似乎并不是出于它的本意。
细胞对气温和湿度的反应很敏感， 导致样子会随意地变化。
根据天气而改变样子。 听说气温和湿度的变化 对细胞有影响。

pokemon.name: 变隐龙
descriptions: 在不隐身的时候，身体的颜色 也会随着心情和状态改变。 颜色越浓的时候越有精神。
能改变身体的颜色，融入周围景色中。 如果长时间不管它，就会闹别扭不现身。

pokemon.name: 怨影娃娃
descriptions: 流传着这样的古老俗语， 日暮时分，不要去 排列着怨影娃娃的房子。
因为会吞食类似于 怨恨、嫉妒之类的感情， 所以对于有的人来说是可贵的存在。

pokemon.name: 诅咒娃娃
descriptions: 因被丢弃的怨念而诞生。 听说，如果满足它受重视的需求， 就会变回原来的玩偶。
怨念附在被丢弃的玩偶身上， 打算寻找丢弃自己的人来报仇。

pokemon.name: 夜巡灵
descriptions: 会让身体变透明， 然后偷偷地靠近猎物。 拥有穿过厚墙壁的能力。
据说，一旦发现不听话的孩子， 就会在深夜将其带去某个地方。

pokemon.name: 彷徨夜灵
descriptions: 寻找游走的灵魂，吸入自己 空洞的身体里。没人知道 被吸入后会发生什么事。
身体内部是空的。 只要一张开嘴就会像 黑洞一样吸入所有东西

pokemon.name: 热带龙
descriptions: 脖子上的那串水果很美味， 很受欢迎。在温暖的地方， 有许多培育热带龙的牧场。
栖息在阿罗拉的热带龙 脖子里结的那串水果比其他地区的 甜得多，是最最棒的。

pokemon.name: 风铃铃
descriptions: Can emit waves of air powerful enough to knock out prey taller than itself. I hypothesize that it amplifies the faint sound of wind within its body.
In high winds, Chimecho cries as it hangs from a tree branch or the eaves of a building using a suction cup on its head. This Pokémon plucks berries with its long tail and eats them.
Chimecho makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this Pokémon becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.
Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.
It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.

pokemon.name: 阿勃梭鲁
descriptions: 由于拥有感知危险的能力， 因此它被人们误解为是 会招来灾祸的宝可梦。
如风一般在山野中奔跑。 能用它像弓一样的角 来感知自然灾害的预兆。
老人们称之为灾祸宝可梦， 对它很忌惮。但人们对它 预知灾害的能力非常感兴趣。
不祥的只是它的外表。 实际上它是会帮忙守护田地， 或是告知人们异变的难能可贵的存在。
被认为会带来灾祸， 而实际上性格很温和。 会向人传递灾害危机的信息。

pokemon.name: 小果然
descriptions: 具有集体行动的习性。 睡觉的时候会聚集在洞窟中， 和伙伴们把身体挨在一起。
和大群伙伴一起行动， 通过和伙伴彼此推挤 来锻炼自己的忍耐力。

pokemon.name: 雪童子
descriptions: 只能在寒冷的土地上生存。 即使在零下１００度的环境下 也能充满活力地到处蹦蹦跳跳。
据说半夜出现的 雪童子会带来大雪。 靠吃雪和冰为生。
寒冷地方的富人们， 好像都会有小时候 和雪童子一起玩的回忆。
雪和冰是它的主要食物。 在温暖的阿罗拉只能在 限定的地方生存。
只能在寒冷的土地上生存。 即使在零下１００度的环境下 也能充满活力地到处蹦蹦跳跳哦。

pokemon.name: 冰鬼护
descriptions: 用令空气中的水分 瞬间冻结的力量， 将猎物冰冻起来。
拥有火焰也无法融化的 冰之躯体。能让空气中的 水分在一瞬间冻结。
不那么坚硬的岩石是它的本体。 能够冻住空气中的水分， 将冰之装甲裹在身上。
将猎物冻住，整个咬住。 但喜欢吃的是迷你冰等 原本就冻着的宝可梦。
从大大的嘴巴里喷出冷气， 把猎物瞬间冻得硬邦邦的。 就这么嘎嘣嘎嘣地享用食物。

pokemon.name: 海豹球
descriptions: 会漂浮在波浪当中观察 大海的状况。一旦发现猎物， 就会通知群体里的帝牙海狮。
圆溜溜的身体 被厚厚的脂肪包裹着， 滚起来比走路要快。

pokemon.name: 海魔狮
descriptions: 不管是海豹球还是精灵球， 只要是圆的物体都会 顶在鼻子上转来转去。
在浮冰上生活。能一边游泳 一边分辨猎物的味道，找到 对方的位置并将其捕获。

pokemon.name: 帝牙海狮
descriptions: 它的獠牙一生都会持续生长。 即使在战斗中被折断也能逐渐恢复， 只需要１年的时间便能完好如初。
２、３０只一起群居。 受到敌人袭击时， 首领会拼命保护族群。

pokemon.name: 珍珠贝
descriptions: 珍珠贝的珍珠非常贵重。 据说，其价值或许是 大舌贝珍珠的１０倍以上。
别看它长这样，它可是食肉的。 用２片外壳牢牢夹住猎物， 直到完全不动了才会放开。

pokemon.name: 猎斑鱼
descriptions: 栖息在深海中。 传说，如果猎斑鱼被冲上沙滩， 就会有不祥的事情发生。
游泳能力不太强。 会挥动尾巴来吸引猎物， 在很接近的时候一口咬住。

pokemon.name: 樱花鱼
descriptions: 吸食猎物的体液。 剩下的肉会沉入海底， 成为其他宝可梦的食物。
身体的颜色根据水温而变化。 阿罗拉的樱花鱼呈现出 令人炫目的鲜艳色彩。

pokemon.name: 古空棘鱼
descriptions: 在深海调查中被发现的宝可梦。 样子在１亿年间都没有任何变化， 被人们称为活化石。
如岩石般坚硬的鳞片 和富含脂肪的浮囊使它 能够耐得住深海的水压。
好像作为生命已是完成状态， 所以在１亿年间， 样子完全没有变化。
曾被认为已经灭绝。 古空棘鱼的名字是 模仿发现者的名字而起的。
在深海调查中被偶然发现。 牙齿退化，靠吸食来摄取微生物。

pokemon.name: 爱心鱼
descriptions: 温暖海域的珊瑚礁是它的栖息地。 特别喜欢在太阳珊瑚的枝条间睡觉。
如果拥有它的心形鳞片， 就能交往到恋人。也曾有个时期 因为这个谣传而遭到滥捕。
在情侣中人气很高， 因此被放养在蜜月客人 住宿的酒店泳池里。
变成只有独自１只的爱心鱼 无精打采地，尽是空虚。 就在那时被大嘴鸥叼走了。

pokemon.name: 宝贝龙
descriptions: 不会成群结队，喜欢单独生活。 脑袋很硬，只要猛地一撞， 就能把坚硬的岩石一分为二。
为了有一天能翱翔天空， 每天都从悬崖上跳下来， 坚持训练锻炼身体。
也有说法，说它通过重重地 敲打脑袋来刺激影响进化的细胞。
每次见到在空中飞行的鸟宝可梦， 就会变得非常羡慕， 而用头锤把周围的东西砸得粉碎。
用钢铁般坚硬的脑袋胡乱地 头锤攻击。这是无法飞到 空中的精神压力造成的。

pokemon.name: 甲壳龙
descriptions: 可以不吃食物忍受饥饿。 据说当它用尽积蓄的能量后， 就会开始进化。
覆盖着身体的硬壳 成分和骨头相同。 正在储备进化的能量。
栖息在洞窟的深处， 躲在坚硬的外壳里， 梦想着飞上天空的那一天。
体内的细胞正处于千变万化的时期。 坚硬的壳与骨头的成分相同。
一动不动地潜伏在洞穴深处， 不吃也不喝。 不知为何不会死掉。

pokemon.name: 暴飞龙
descriptions: 虽然在空中翱翔能够让它 乐在其中，但是一旦被惹怒， 就会大闹一番，不可收拾。
一直渴望能飞上天空， 进化后身体上终于长出了 翅膀的珍奇宝可梦。
因为不断强烈地祈求着， 结果身体的细胞发生了突然变异。 终于得到了心心念念的翅膀。
因为终于能飞的喜悦， 而在天空四处疾飞。 不到精疲力竭要睡觉就几乎不落地。
用最后终于长出来的翅膀在浩瀚的 天空翱翔。兴奋地喷出火焰， 将大地变成一片燃烧的原野。

pokemon.name: 铁哑铃
descriptions: 身体的细胞由磁铁构成。 循环于全身的不是血液， 而是磁力。
从臀部发出磁力，猛地 将敌人吸过来，然后用 锐利的爪子把对方刺穿。
如果把它惹恼，不仅会大闹一番， 还会放出强大的磁力， 所以会把机械类的东西都破坏掉。
体内循环着的不是血液而是磁力。 身体状况不好时，就给它磁铁吧。
放出磁力将对手吸到身边的时候， 用臀部的爪子将对方劈开。

pokemon.name: 金属怪
descriptions: 依靠磁力飞行。能够在空中 以高速穿过险峻的山岳， 让追捕的猎物无处可逃。
２只铁哑铃因磁力结合 起来了。因为有了２个大脑， 精神力量也强化到了２倍。
以高速在空中飞来飞去， 如果发现猎物就会用锐利的爪子 牢牢抓住，绝不松开。
会从２个大脑里放射出 强力的精神能量， 封住猎物的行动。
非常喜欢能放出磁力的矿物。 会以１００公里的时速穷追朝北鼻。

pokemon.name: 巨金怪
descriptions: ２只金属怪组合起来的样子。 运用堪比超级计算机的 头脑打败敌人。
由于当气温下降至０度 以下时磁力会增强，栖息在 雪山上的巨金怪特别有活力。
以超越超级计算机的 判断力分析对手， 冷静地将对手逼入绝境。
不只是精神力量，还以怪力而自豪。 能用４只脚抓住猎物， 用爪子封住对方的行动。
２只金属怪组合起来。 通过４个大脑的并行处理， 什么样的计算都只要一瞬间。

pokemon.name: 雷吉洛克
descriptions: 人们通过最新的科学技术 对它的岩石身体做了调查， 但是并未发现大脑和心脏。
身上任何一个部分都由 岩石构成。即使身体磨损了 也会自己用岩石去修补。

pokemon.name: 雷吉艾斯
descriptions: 拥有一副由冰构成的身体。 据说是诞生于冰河时期 冻得厚厚实实的冰块之下。
会操控冰冷至零下２００度 的冷气，将接近自己的 家伙一下子冰镇起来。

pokemon.name: 雷吉斯奇鲁
descriptions: 据说诞生于地幔之中， 在距今约１万年前 现身于地面之上。
虽然也拥有能伸能缩的柔软性， 但它其实是由比任何金属 都要结实的神秘物质构成的。

pokemon.name: 拉帝亚斯
descriptions: Latias is highly intelligent and capable of understanding human speech. It is covered with a glass-like down. The Pokémon enfolds its body with its down and refracts light to alter its appearance.
Latias is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this Pokémon ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.
It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.
It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.
Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

pokemon.name: 拉帝欧斯
descriptions: Latios will only open its heart to a Trainer with a compassionate spirit. This Pokémon can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.
Latios has the ability to make others see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This Pokémon is intelligent and understands human speech.
It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.
A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
It has a docile temperament and dislikes fighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can fly faster than a jet plane.

pokemon.name: 盖欧卡
descriptions: Kyogre is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Groudon, as each sought to gain the power of nature.
Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can summon storms that cause the sea levels to rise.
It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.
A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.
This POKéMON is said to have expanded the sea by bringing heavy rains. It has the power to control water.

pokemon.name: 固拉多
descriptions: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can cause magma to erupt and expand the landmass of the world.
Groudon is said to be the personification of the land itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Kyogre, as each sought to gain the power of nature.
This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.
Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.
It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.

pokemon.name: 烈空坐
descriptions: It flies forever through the ozone layer, consuming meteoroids for sustenance. The many meteoroids in its body provide the energy it needs to Mega Evolve.
Rayquaza is said to have lived for hundreds of millions of years. Legends remain of how it put to rest the clash between Kyogre and Groudon.
It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.
It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
It has lived for hundreds of millions of years in the ozone layer. Its flying form looks like a meteor.

pokemon.name: 基拉祈
descriptions: 传说当它从１０００年的 沉睡中醒来时，会实现 写在它头部许愿笺上的愿望。
每１０００年让它听一次 清澈的歌声，就能让它 维持７天的清醒。

pokemon.name: 代欧奇希斯
descriptions: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.
The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in Deoxys. The crystalline organ on this Pokémon’s chest appears to be its brain.
DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.
An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
When it changes form, an aurora appears. It absorbs attacks by altering its cellular structure.

pokemon.name: 草苗龟
descriptions: This Pokémon becomes more energetic the more sunlight there is. The part resembling a shell is similar to silt and is slightly damp and warm to the touch.
It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.
Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.
The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell should feel moist.
Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

pokemon.name: 树林龟
descriptions: Appears where there is clean spring water. The fruit that grows on the shrubs on its shell is sweet, nutritious, and truly delicious.
It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.
It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
The shell is hardened soil. Some Pokémon come to peck the berries growing on the trees on its back.
A GROTLE that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.

pokemon.name: 土台龟
descriptions: This remarkable, large-bodied Pokémon would serve beautifully as borrowed scenery for a garden, and its strength is peerless. Torterra roams the wilderness in search of clean water.
Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.
Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra’s back and spend their entire life there.
Groups of this Pokémon migrating in search of water have been mistaken for “moving forests.”

pokemon.name: 小火焰猴
descriptions: Full of vigor and always in high spirits. It was once known by the name ”Lantern-Tail” and feared as some kind of apparition.
The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.
Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.
It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.
It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

pokemon.name: 猛火猴
descriptions: The deeper the blue on its face, the more powerful it will grow to become. It leaps about every which way and lands powerful blows against its opponents with the flame on its tail.
It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.
It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.
A bigger fire on its tail and a brighter blue pattern on its face means its rank in its pack is higher.
To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.

pokemon.name: 烈焰猴
descriptions: A tall, hardy Pokémon with a dazzling appearance. It shrouds itself in flame and battles as if engaged in dance—truly a sight to behold.
It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.
Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.
It uses unique fighting moves with fire on its hands and feet. It will take on any opponent.
It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

pokemon.name: 波加曼
descriptions: Prefers cold climes and appears along coasts. It's an adorable little thing—as cute as any child—but it's also prideful, unwilling to accept handouts from people.
Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.
A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.
It lives along shores in northern countries. A skilled swimmer, it dives for over 10 minutes to hunt.

pokemon.name: 波皇子
descriptions: It swims gracefully through the frigid sea and sings with a voice like the roaring tide. It has powerful, sturdy wings and dignity to match.
It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.
It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.
Its wings deliver wicked blows that snap even the thickest of trees. It searches for prey in icy seas.

pokemon.name: 帝王拿波
descriptions: Since ancient times, it has been revered by the people of Hisui, who call it the Master of the Waves. Its wings are a match for even master-crafted blades.
The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.
If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.
It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate anything that threatens its pride.

pokemon.name: 姆克儿
descriptions: They live in the fields and mountains, gathering in large flocks. Their cries are quite obnoxious. Though small, their wings are strong—a strike from them leaves pain that persists for a week.
They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.
They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.
Usually with a large flock, it is barely noticeable when alone. Its cries are very strident.

pokemon.name: 姆克鸟
descriptions: They form remarkably large flocks and are constantly fighting amongst themselves. I suspect that those with magnificent plumes on their heads are the strong ones.
It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.
They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.
Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.
It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

pokemon.name: 姆克鹰
descriptions: It has left the flock, having gained strength enough to survive on its own. The astounding force with which Staraptor flies through the air allows it to carry away large, burly targets.
When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.
The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.
It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.
It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

pokemon.name: 大牙狸
descriptions: Bidoof has an unsophisticated face and is rarely flustered by anything. There have been incidents involving Bidoof sauntering into villages and gnawing on the houses without a single care.
It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.
With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
A comparison revealed that Bidoof’s front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata’s.
It lives in groups by the water. It chews up boulders and trees around its nest with its incisors.

pokemon.name: 大尾狸
descriptions: Bibarel fur repels water and is also a fantastic material for heat retention. These Pokémon create dams on rivers to live in.
It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.
A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.
While its movements out of water are sluggish, it can swim as fast as any FEEBAS.

pokemon.name: 圆法师
descriptions: When the trees take on new hues, more of these Pokémon appear. The tone they create by striking their antennae together resembles that of the marimba, an instrument of foreign lands.
When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.
It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.
Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.
It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.

pokemon.name: 音箱蟀
descriptions: It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.
It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.
It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.
By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its belly, it produces a captivating sound.

pokemon.name: 小猫怪
descriptions: 体毛通电后就会发光。 会摇晃明亮发光的尾巴 尖端来向伙伴发送信号。
靠伸缩肌肉来制造电能。 如果看到它兴奋地浑身颤抖， 就说明它正在猛烈发电。

pokemon.name: 勒克猫
descriptions: 遇到敌人时会从脚 伸出有着百万伏特 威力的爪子来迎战。
当把尾巴和伙伴连接在一起时， 可以分享到对方的电能， 从而释放出更加强力的电击。

pokemon.name: 伦琴猫
descriptions: 由于透视需要消耗 大量的电能，因此它会 睡很长时间来积蓄能量。
拥有透视能力的宝可梦。 能够立刻发现身处于 厚厚墙壁另一侧的猎物。

pokemon.name: 含羞苞
descriptions: 对气温的变化很敏感。 当它开始打开花苞， 便是冬去春来之时。
会散布带有毒素的花粉。 培育时所用的水越干净， 所含有的毒性就越高。

pokemon.name: 罗丝雷朵
descriptions: 右手的毒是速效的， 左手的毒则是慢性的。 无论哪边的毒性都能致命。
会用馥郁芬芳的花香 迷惑敌人，并用荆棘上 的鞭子猛力抽打对方。

pokemon.name: 头盖龙
descriptions: 坚硬的头盖骨是其特征。 会用头锤撞断树木， 吃树上结的树果。
太古时代的宝可梦。 拥有坚硬而结实的头盖骨， 但是脑子相当不好使。
在发现头盖龙化石的 地层里也一并出土了 被锤断了的树木的化石。
生活在大约１亿年前的密林中。 用最拿手的头锤对抗化石翼龙。

pokemon.name: 战槌龙
descriptions: 擅长头锤的古代宝可梦。 因为大脑真的很小， 所以也有说法它是因愚笨而灭亡的。
过去的人们曾在挖出化石后， 用比钢铁还硬的头盖骨做成头盔。
曾经有过复原进化后的 战槌龙逃之夭夭， 用头锤破坏高层建筑的记录。
反复使出头锤的头盖骨变得又硬又厚。 但脑子比起头盖龙有所缩减。

pokemon.name: 盾甲龙
descriptions: 虽然从太古时代的地层中 发现了它的化石， 但尚未发现除了脸以外的部分。
食草的温顺宝可梦。 用结实的脸部皮肤挖掘地面， 连树根之类的也会吃。
看来多亏了那张结实的脸， 敌人也少了。 栖息在太古时代的丛林里。
大量的化石被发现， 但是几乎没有 脸的部分有损伤或缺失的情况。

pokemon.name: 护城龙
descriptions: 大约１亿年前的宝可梦。 极其结实的脸有着超越钢铁的硬度。
脸部的骨头又大又硬， 所以在复原成功前， 一直被错误地认作了脊椎。
与战槌龙生活在相似的地方。 也曾发现过２只互相争斗 一起倒下后变成的化石。
如果是从正面的话， 可以防住所有的攻击， 但从后方被袭的话就束手无策了。

pokemon.name: 结草儿
descriptions: If its cloak is even slightly damaged, Burmy will immediately repair it with whatever is close at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.
If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.
To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.
It covers itself with a cloak to shelter from the cold. When it’s hot, its cloak is thinner.

pokemon.name: 结草贵妇
descriptions: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.
Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.
When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.
It is said that a WORMADAM that evolves on a cold day will have a thicker cloak.

pokemon.name: 绅士蛾
descriptions: Scatters steel-colored scales as it flaps its wings. Despite being observed feeding primarily on the nectar of flowers, Mothim is not often seen around flower gardens.
It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.
It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.
While it loves floral honey, it won’t gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from Combee.
It does not keep a nest. It flies over fields and mountains in constant search of floral honey.

pokemon.name: 三蜜蜂
descriptions: 从早到晚都在采集花蜜。 这一切都是为了 自己的族群和蜂女王。
３只一直都在一起， 但每一只对花蜜的 喜好却略有不同。

pokemon.name: 蜂女王
descriptions: 能释放越多费洛蒙的蜂女王， 就能让越多的三蜜蜂 听从自己的指挥。
自由自在地指挥孩子们 与敌人战斗。孩子们会 为了蜂女王而拼上性命。

pokemon.name: 帕奇利兹
descriptions: A species related to the Pikachu line. Though Pachirisu is a calm Pokémon, it still presents a danger should one touch its electrified tail or cheeks.
A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.
It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.
It makes electricity with pouches in its cheeks and shoots charges from its tail. It lives atop trees.

pokemon.name: 泳圈鼬
descriptions: It moves freely in the water by spinning its forked tail for propulsion. The resemblance to the screw of a steamboat is coincidental.
It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.
It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.
It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.
It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.

pokemon.name: 浮潜鼬
descriptions: Has a long, rather splendid flotation sac, which prevents Floatzel from drowning even in stormy seas. One might glimpse this species around fishing hamlets from time to time.
Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.
It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.
With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

pokemon.name: 樱花宝
descriptions: 身体越红的樱花宝 含有的营养越丰富， 味道也很甜很好吃。
它营养丰富的小球 是鸟宝可梦的最爱。 为了不被啄到而四处逃跑。

pokemon.name: 樱花儿
descriptions: 盖起来的花瓣很硬。 即使被鸟宝可梦啄到， 也完全没问题。
花苞形态时性格稳重， 几乎不会动，只是静静地 等待太阳光的出现。

pokemon.name: 无壳海兔
descriptions: 如果用力按住它， 它就会分泌出神秘的紫色液体。 虽然液体无害，不过黏糊糊的。
样子会因环境不同而改变。 也有人说它到了温暖的 海里就会变成这个样子。
如果感到危险，就会分泌出紫色的汁。 人们认为这是类似于虚汗的东西。
平常在海里生活， 但只要皮肤没有干燥， 也可以在陆地活动。
一旦接触，紫色的粘液就 会粘到手上。即使反复洗 也不怎么能洗掉，所以要注意。

pokemon.name: 海兔兽
descriptions: 身体软瘫瘫的但十分强韧。 因为它身体的软度可以 帮助分散它所受到的冲击。
为了觅食也会登上陆地。 海兔兽经过的地方 会留下黏糊糊的粘液。
受栖息地和食物的影响， 颜色和形状会发生变化。 在波浪平稳的岩岸有很多。
曾经一直背着壳。 在背的里面有着 又硬又薄的壳的痕迹。
无形的浮游生物是它的主要食物。 会到陆地上来，但原因尚不清楚。

pokemon.name: 双尾怪手
descriptions: 无论做什么都会用到尾巴。 如果被它的２条尾巴抱紧， 那就证明是真的和你很亲近。
围绕着舒适的树木的问题， 一直在和投掷猴群体争夺领地。 但结果是五五分。

pokemon.name: 飘飘球
descriptions: 因魂魄聚集在一起而诞生。 到了湿气大的季节 就有可能大量出现。
也许是因为渴望拥有伙伴， 它会去接近孩子们。但也经常 因为被孩子们戏耍而逃跑。
在路上游荡的魂魄们聚积诞生而成。 想让孩子成为自己的伙伴 而去拉他们的手。
圆圆的身体里塞满了许多魂魄。 每次带着谁一起走的时候， 身体就会鼓起来。
身体因某种原因弄破的话， 就会伴随着呼喊一样的声音 溢出魂魄来。

pokemon.name: 随风球
descriptions: 会抓住人和宝可梦， 然后运到某个地方。 没人知道那地方是哪里。
也有人说它是万念俱灰的 灵魂聚在一起的样子。 会在黑夜里静静地飘荡。
体内气体的原料是魂魄。 据说如果身体变得干瘪， 就会把人和宝可梦带走。
谣传说，如果被乘着风 在暮色里飞行的随风球捉住， 就会被运送往那个世界。
日暮时分飞行的大群随风球， 即使一直盯着观察， 也会在一不留神间消失。

pokemon.name: 卷卷耳
descriptions: 会利用把卷卷的耳朵伸直 时产生的威力进行攻击。 越训练，这一招式的威力就越强。
若看到它卷起左右两只耳朵， 就说明它此时身体和心理 状态不佳，需要呵护。
一只耳朵一直卷着 是为了被敌人袭击的时候 能立即反击。
手脚的力量很弱， 但如果死命伸长紧紧卷起的耳朵， 连大岩石也能粉碎。

pokemon.name: 长耳兔
descriptions: 当高温的季节结束后， 就会换上富含空气的 体毛，准备抵御寒冷。
一直注意着周围的状况， 遇到危险时便会施展 破坏力超群的踢击。
警戒心很强，不喜欢战斗， 但能够用柔软的脚使出有力的脚踢。
一年会换２次毛。 用这个毛制作的 围巾和帽子非常温暖。

pokemon.name: 梦妖魔
descriptions: 会吟诵诅咒的语言， 让对方极度头疼，或是看到 恐怖的幻觉，深受折磨。
因为四处作祟，播撒诅咒 而被人们所恐惧。 也会随性地使用帮助人类的咒文。
因为也会施加实现恋爱愿望的咒语， 所以也有拼命寻找梦妖魔的人。
不知从何处出现， 碎碎念着咒文，施加诅咒， 制造恐怖的幻象。

pokemon.name: 乌鸦头头
descriptions: 和敌人战斗的基本都是跟班。 只有在最后刺入对手的致命一击 才会弄脏自己的手。
绝对不能容忍失败或是背叛的跟班。 是为了维持群体的秩序， 不得已而为之的。
对于捕猎失败还有 背叛了的黑暗鸦跟班们， 无论天涯海角都会穷追过去处罚。
夜行性。只要鸣叫一声， 就会有超过１００只的 黑暗鸦跟班聚集起来。

pokemon.name: 魅力喵
descriptions: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.
When it’s happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.
It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
It hides its spiteful tendency of hooking its claws into the nose of its Trainer if it isn’t fed.
With its sharp glare, it puts foes in a mild hypnotic state. It is a very fickle Pokémon.

pokemon.name: 东施喵
descriptions: Though impudent and difficult to tame, Purugly enjoys great popularity due to its fur, the beauty of which surpasses even velveteen.
To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.
It would claim another Pokémon’s nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.
It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger. If it locks eyes, it will glare ceaselessly.
It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.

pokemon.name: 铃铛响
descriptions: This Pokémon gave me an excruciating headache when it seemingly cried out without making a sound. Perhaps there are some sounds that the human ear is simply incapable of hearing.
There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.
Each time it hops, it makes a ringing sound. It deafens foes by emitting high-frequency cries.
It emits high-frequency cries that people can’t hear. Once it starts, it can cry for an awfully long time.
It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

pokemon.name: 臭鼬噗
descriptions: 要是它翘起尾巴把屁股对准了你， 请一定要小心。因为这表示它将要 喷出足以让人窒息的臭液。
瞄准对手的脸，从屁股 喷出奇臭无比的液体。 液体能喷到５米开外。

pokemon.name: 坦克臭鼬
descriptions: 从尾巴尖端喷出的液体 带有强烈的恶臭。 会在地面上挖洞建造巢穴。
会在肚子里囤满臭液， 从尾巴喷出臭液攻击敌人。 臭味会因吃下的东西而不同。

pokemon.name: 铜镜怪
descriptions: 虽然人们说把铜镜怪打磨到发光， 它就能映照出真相， 但其实它非常讨厌被打磨。
会在古老的遗迹出现。 身上的纹路不属于伽勒尔文化， 因此至今仍然谜团重重。

pokemon.name: 青铜钟
descriptions: 它身上的纹路让 许多学者都认为它 原本并不存在于伽勒尔。
被称为能召唤雨云的神明。 生气时会用像钟声一般令人 毛骨悚然的声音来威吓对手。

pokemon.name: 盆才怪
descriptions: 栖息在空气干燥岩石裸露的地方。 空气越是干燥，它身上的绿球 就越是会泛出暗淡的光泽。
会从眼睛里排出汗和泪水。 它的汗水有一点点咸， 泪水则略微带着一些苦味。
如果身体过于潮湿就会死掉， 因此会像分泌汗液那样 从眼睛里排出水分。
会从眼睛里排出水分。 看起来就像是正在哭泣， 所以似乎也有让敌人麻痹大意的效果。
会从眼睛排出体内多余的水分。 该成分接近人类的汗液。

pokemon.name: 魔尼尼
descriptions: 像徒弟一样跟随着 擅长跳舞的踏冰人偶， 拼命模仿它的舞步。
会模仿一切进入眼帘的事物。 一心一意模仿踏冰人偶 华丽的舞步，不停地练习。
擅长模仿。如果对方因此大吃一惊， 它就会很开心，甚至不知不觉 忘记了自己正在模仿这件事。
会拼命地模仿对方的动作和表情。 但还说不上模仿得很好。

pokemon.name: 小福蛋
descriptions: 会把自己珍贵的浑圆石头 借给关系变得很要好的对象。 如果不还给它，它便会大哭大闹。
模仿吉利蛋，把很像蛋的 浑圆石头放入腹部的 袋子中用心保管着。
如果看到又白又圆的东西 就会放到腹部的袋子里。 有时甚至会放得太多而动弹不得。
是非常温顺的宝可梦， 但如果被夺走了腹部的圆石头， 就会哭着大吵大闹。
腹部的袋子里装着白色的 圆形石头。如果关系变好， 也可能会分给你哦。

pokemon.name: 聒噪鸟
descriptions: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.
It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.
Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.
It keeps rhythm by flicking its tail feathers like a metronome. It imitates human speech.

pokemon.name: 花岩怪
descriptions: 总是作恶多端， 于是被使用神奇法术的 旅人绑缚在楔石里。
由１０８个灵魂聚在一起 变成了宝可梦，但似乎有 性格恶劣的灵魂混在里面。

pokemon.name: 圆陆鲨
descriptions: 遇到会动的东西就会扑上去 将其拉回到自己住的横洞内。 虽然嘴很大，但胃口却比较小。
喜欢因地热而温暖的 狭窄横洞，这样一来就算 外面刮暴风雪也不会冻着了。
原本栖息在比阿罗拉更热的地方。 一起住的话，要花很多暖气费。
会对动的东西发生反应， 飞扑过去咬住。有时候 会伤到自己，但也不太在意。
潜伏在地洞内，如果有猎物 或敌人经过，就会扑出来咬住。 有时会用力过猛牙齿豁掉。

pokemon.name: 尖牙陆鲨
descriptions: 会把宝石埋藏在栖息的洞窟内。 入侵者闯入洞窟后，会立刻 被它用爪子和牙齿撕碎。
会从头部左右两边的 突起物发出超音波， 观察漆黑洞窟中的状况。
会反复蜕皮变大。 将鳞片磨成粉， 可以作为中药的原料。
非常喜欢发光的东西。 如果发现正在攻击小碎钻的勾魂眼， 就会非常生气地发动袭击。
最喜欢闪闪发光的东西。 一直呆在巢穴里， 盯着宝石和捕捉到的小碎钻。

pokemon.name: 烈咬陆鲨
descriptions: 身手在陆地上也很矫捷， 在雪山上会赶在身体冻僵前 干掉猎物并返回住处。
在火山区的山上栖息。 会以不输给喷气式飞机的 速度飞到天空中寻找猎物。
细小又尖锐的鳞片， 不但可以减少空气的阻力， 还能使来袭击的对手受伤。
以音速飞行，寻找猎物。 围绕着食物的问题， 和暴飞龙展开空中战。
头上长着的２个突起物 是起感应器作用的。 前方很远处猎物的样子也能知道。

pokemon.name: 小卡比兽
descriptions: 在体毛下面储存食物。 如果是自己信赖的对象， 也会把食物分给对方一口。
总之全神贯注地大吃大喝， 完全不去讲究食物的味道， 就算是腐烂的东西也照吃不误。
只要是看着能吃的东西，就先捡起来 一口吞下。拥有强韧的胃， 即便是腐烂的食物也不要紧。
长长的毛发下面藏着食物， 但有时也会忘记藏了东西 而发生异臭的问题。
一旦找到看起来能吃的东西， 就不管三七二十一先捡起来吞了。 所以就这么一天天地变胖起来。

pokemon.name: 利欧路
descriptions: 除了能读懂对手的感情， 也能以“波导”这种形式的波 来观察大自然的样子。
精力充沛，可以奔跑一整夜。 由于它十分活泼， 带它散步的人非常辛苦。
会使用一种叫做波导的波 来和伙伴交流。由于交流时无需鸣叫， 因此不会被敌人发现。
能看见被称为波导的一种波， 感知人和宝可梦的心情。 不会靠近危险的对手。
能跑整整一晚上， 是非常坚毅勤奋的家伙， 不过仍然是毛头小子。

pokemon.name: 路卡利欧
descriptions: 他能理解人类的想法， 因此只会去亲近 内心端正的训练家。
操纵一种被称为波导的力量 来进行狩猎。这种力量就连 巨大的岩石也能击得粉碎。
用波导来侦测对手的心情。 不想知道的事情也会知道， 所以很容易累积压力。
它集中精神所放出的一种 神奇的波，被称为波导， 连巨大的岩石都能击得粉碎。
能侦测到１公里开外 生物的种类和心情。 操纵波导以群体形式狩猎。

pokemon.name: 沙河马
descriptions: 主要在白天活动。 因为沙漠的夜晚会降温， 所以会钻到沙子的深处睡觉。
张大嘴巴移动，连同沙子 把对手一整个吞下去。 会从鼻孔把沙子喷出来丢掉。

pokemon.name: 河马兽
descriptions: 生气的时候非常凶暴。 会喷出储存在体内的 沙子来引发沙尘暴。
偶尔会有石子卡在身体的孔洞里。 因为石居蟹会帮忙把石子拿出来， 所以会用心地保护它们。

pokemon.name: 钳尾蝎
descriptions: 用尾巴上带毒的钩爪袭击对手。 一旦被夹住，毒素就会扩散开来， 导致全身无法动弹。
将自己的身体埋在沙子里， 一声不响地等待猎物。 祖先和烧火蚣的祖先是近亲。

pokemon.name: 龙王蝎
descriptions: 虽然狰狞凶猛到被人们 称为沙之恶魔，但在河马兽 面前却表现得低调温顺。
虽然拥有剧毒，但只有在 极少数的情况下才会使用。 会用能敲烂汽车的怪力乱打一通。

pokemon.name: 不良蛙
descriptions: 毒素在稀释后能制成药品。 它是制药公司的吉祥物， 广受众人的欢迎。
会从自己脸颊上的毒囊 发出声音来威吓对手， 趁对手畏惧的时间使出毒击。

pokemon.name: 毒骷蛙
descriptions: 制服了猎物之后， 便会呱呱地发出胜利的欢呼。 与蟾蜍王是相近的物种。
一跃而起接近敌人， 用有毒的爪子狠抓对方！ 光是擦伤就能将对手ＫＯ。

pokemon.name: 尖牙笼
descriptions: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.
It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.
It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
Using its tentacles to lash itself to trees, it lies in wait for prey, luring it close with sweet-smelling drool.
It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling drool and gulps them down.

pokemon.name: 荧光鱼
descriptions: 用发光的尾鳍引诱猎物。 白天会在海面附近， 到了夜里就向海的深处移动。
粉红色的花纹到了夜里就会发光。 很受潜水者欢迎， 所以有时会被驯养在度假地。
用２片尾鳍活力四射地跳跃。 跳出海面的那一刻， 会被长翅鸥叼走。
粉红色的那部分皮肤 会储存太阳光并发光。 听说是用来做保护色的。

pokemon.name: 霓虹鱼
descriptions: 像是爬行一样在深海的海底游泳。 鳍上发出的充满幻想的光 就像是夜空的星星。
深海的海底猎物很少。 四处寻找宝贵的食物， 和电灯怪展开激烈争夺。
栖息在海底的深海宝可梦。 使用鳍在海底爬行， 寻找爱吃的宝石海星。
利用光来诱惑猎物靠近， 但是作为天敌的凶猛 鱼宝可梦也靠了过来。

pokemon.name: 小球飞鱼
descriptions: 混在铁炮鱼的大群里游泳。 受到敌人袭击的时候， 会和铁炮鱼们并肩作战。
也许是因为海水温度偏低， 伽勒尔地区的小球飞鱼 动作似乎有点迟缓。
不认生，会靠近人类的船只。 背上的花纹根据地域而有所不同。
非常不认生，很容易亲近。 与小球飞鱼的互动巡游 是非常受欢迎的海滩活动。

pokemon.name: 雪笠怪
descriptions: 雪笠怪肚子上结出来的 口感好似冰棍的树果 是伽勒尔的火红不倒翁们的最爱。
生活在积雪深厚的山上。 会通过把脚踩进积雪中 来吸收水分和冷气。

pokemon.name: 暴雪王
descriptions: 会引发暴风雪的宝可梦。 只要它摇动巨大的身体， 周围立刻会变得一片雪白。
会像挥动锤子一样挥下自己 大大的手臂，赶走要袭击 雪笠怪的火红不倒翁群体。

pokemon.name: 玛狃拉
descriptions: 通过用爪子留下记号 来与伙伴联络。据说记号 的种类有５００种以上。
成群结队袭击猎物。 通过团队合作，连象牙猪那样 强大的对手也能轻松解决。
变聪明了， 不会因为食物的分配而打架。 如果被它的爪子勾到就会冻伤。
１只负责绊住穿山鼠的脚， 将其翻过来后，另１只用 锐利的爪子给予致命一击。
生活在寒冷的地方， 在阿罗拉以六尾和穿山鼠为主要食物。 伙伴之间会认真地分配猎物。

pokemon.name: 自爆磁怪
descriptions: 人们认为，它是因为受到特殊 磁场的影响，身体的分子构造 发生了变化，才进化成这样的。
据说它通过头部的天线 接收来自宇宙的电波， 受到未知对象的操控。
直至今日仍有人们相信 它是来自宇宙的。 会释放出强力的磁力。
用雷达监视着自己的领地。 一旦发现入侵者， 就会立即用破坏光线惩治。
据说会一边在空中来回飞行， 一边发送怪异电波 和接收未知电波。

pokemon.name: 大舌舔
descriptions: 舌头的灵巧程度甚至不输给 人手，没有它做不到的事。 相反，手指却相当笨拙，
拥有不可思议的舌头， 全伸出来能有身体的数倍之长。 其不可思议之谜至今仍未解开。
比起手脚，它更擅长使用舌头。 哪怕是１粒小小的豆子也能灵活地摘下。
会举行看谁舌头伸得远的大赛。 目前的最高纪录是２５米。

pokemon.name: 超甲狂犀
descriptions: 用护具弹开敌人的攻击， 在对手畏缩时用自己 引以为傲的钻头贯穿对方。
会在手掌的洞里塞进岩石和 石丸子发射出去，每只手里 可以装填３个。

pokemon.name: 巨蔓藤
descriptions: 栖息的地域越是温暖，藤蔓 生长得就越快。藤蔓变长后， 它会亲手将其扯断使其变短。
最近的研究表明，它那 能够自由伸长的２个手臂 其实是由藤蔓聚集而成的。

pokemon.name: 电击魔兽
descriptions: 发电量在电气宝可梦当中 属于最高级别。可以从 尾巴尖端释放高压电流。
发电量和心率成比例。 一到战斗的时候， 电压就会急速上升。
只要１只电击魔兽就能 提供一座大城市的建筑物 １年所需的全部电力。
握住冒着电火花的尾巴 做成带电的拳头后， 就会用尽全力猛殴。
兴奋的时候会捶胸鸣叫。 每到那时，电火花会飞溅， 雷声会在四周回响。

pokemon.name: 鸭嘴炎兽
descriptions: 由于栖息在火山口，因此 身体逐渐变得像火山一样， 还长着类似岩浆库的器官。
大口吸气之后腹中的 火焰就会烧得更旺， 达到摄氏２０００度。
发射出火球，一招制敌。 因为会把对方弄得焦黑， 所以在捕捉猎物时不会使用。
至今仍依靠鸭嘴炎兽的火焰 来加工金属的工厂也不少。
从手腕处发射出 摄氏２０００度的火球。 连射时手腕会稍稍熔化。

pokemon.name: 波克基斯
descriptions: 被称为会带来恩惠的宝可梦， 从很久很久以前开始， 人们就视它为吉祥之物。
不会出现在发生 争端和纷乱的地方。 近来几乎见不到它的身影。

pokemon.name: 远古巨蜓
descriptions: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.
This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.
It prefers to battle by biting apart foes’ heads instantly while flying by at high speed.
Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.
The beat of its wings is so powerful that it accidentally dislodges full-grown trees when it takes off in flight.

pokemon.name: 叶伊布
descriptions: 尾巴好似锐利的刀刃， 锋利得无与伦比， 连大树都能一斩为二。
伽勒尔人对它叶片散发出的 独特香气情有独钟。用这种 香气加工出的香水非常受欢迎。
通过光合作用补充营养。 在有清澈河流的森林深处 静静地生活着。
本身并不好斗，但如果是为了 保护伙伴，就会削尖尾巴上的叶片， 变成刀刃来作战。
越是年幼的叶伊布， 越是有冲鼻的青草香味。 年老后就变成好像落叶的味道。

pokemon.name: 冰伊布
descriptions: 冰伊布释放出的冷气能 制造出粉状的雪。这使它受到 各个滑雪场的热烈欢迎。
能够降下冰晶。 被它的美貌迷住的猎物 会在不知不觉间被冻住。
能瞬间将周围的水分冻住， 做成冰粒，朝着猎物发射出去。
把体毛冻住， 变成锐利的针来保护身体。 体温最低可下降到零下６０度。
把体毛冻得像锐利的冰柱 那样尖之后，朝猎物冲撞过去。

pokemon.name: 天蝎王
descriptions: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.
Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.
It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
It dances silently through the sky. When it approaches prey, it can land a critical hit in an instant.
If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.

pokemon.name: 象牙猪
descriptions: 它的力量就如外表那样强大。 天气越是寒冷，它的冰牙 就会长得越粗、越长、越结实。
在1万年前的壁画上也能见到 它的身影。曾有一段时期， 人们认为它已经灭绝了。

pokemon.name: 多边兽乙型
descriptions: 有人说它是通过追加程序进化的， 但关于它的改变是否真是进化， 在学会中也存在着意见分歧。
在追加了能够进出 异次元空间的程序之后， 运行状况就不稳定了。
追加的程序不太好。 因为其怪异的举动很惹人注目， 所以或许是实验失败了。
不稳定的举动很惹人注目。 这问题好像要归咎于负责 升级程序的技术人员的水平。
为了在异次元空间行动而 更新了程序，但是其怪异的 举动却很惹人注目。

pokemon.name: 艾路雷朵
descriptions: 能够敏锐地感知到 寻求帮助的感情， 并且火速赶去援助对方。
被称为武神的宝可梦。 只有在为了保护什么的时候 才会去使用自己的肘刀。

pokemon.name: 大朝北鼻
descriptions: 使用３个小部件获取食物， 或是和敌人战斗。 本体基本上只负责下命令。
操纵着被称为小朝北鼻的部件， 但这些部件好像偶尔也会迷路，没法回来。
可以本体不动， 自由操纵被称为小朝北鼻的 ３个部件来捕捉猎物。
因为会释放强大的磁力， 所以导致附近的电器都变得无法使用。

pokemon.name: 黑夜魔灵
descriptions: 用腹部的嘴将猎物整个吞下。 只会吃掉对方的魂魄， 离去时会把肉体吐出来。
没人知道它是否拥有意识。 会从来自灵界的电波中接受指示， 将人和宝可梦带走。

pokemon.name: 雪妖女
descriptions: 会吐出零下５０度的冷气 冻住猎物，并把它们带回 自己的巢穴，整齐地摆成一排。
从在雪山遇难的女性的 遗恨让这宝可梦诞生。 它最喜欢冻成冰的灵魂。
据说会在刮着猛烈暴风雪的夜晚下山， 前往人类居住的村落。 所以即使听到敲门声也千万不能开门。
把前来爬雪山的登山男 冻成冰块，带回自己的巢穴。 而且只会盯上美男子。
在雪山遇难的女性魂魄 附体在冰柱上。 喜欢吃男性的魂魄。

pokemon.name: 洛托姆
descriptions: 会用由离子构成的身体 潜入各种各样的机器里。 最喜欢恶作剧吓人。
某位少年的发明 促使人们开始制造 各种活用洛托姆的机器 。

pokemon.name: 由克希
descriptions: A Pokémon feared but also respected for stealing away the memories of evildoers. I have found records that suggest Uxie holds dominion over knowledge.
It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.
Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
When Uxie flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge.
According to some sources, this Pokémon provided people with the intelligence necessary to solve various problems.

pokemon.name: 艾姆利多
descriptions: Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.
It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake’s surface.
Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
When Mesprit flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.
This Pokémon is said to have endowed the human heart with emotions, such as sorrow and joy.

pokemon.name: 亚克诺姆
descriptions: The dreaded Being of Willpower. Legends tell of this Pokémon manipulating the will of its adversaries and turning them into puppets of its own.
It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf all came from the same egg.
Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
When Azelf flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.
This Pokémon is said to have endowed humans with the determination needed to face any of life’s difficulties.

pokemon.name: 帝牙卢卡
descriptions: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.
It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born.
A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when Dialga’s heart beats.
This Pokémon completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.

pokemon.name: 帕路奇亚
descriptions: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.
It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.
A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with Palkia’s every breath.
Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.

pokemon.name: 席多蓝恩
descriptions: Stories tell of this Pokémon being birthed from the boiling magma within Mount Coronet. Its molten-steel body holds many mysteries.
Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.
It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
Its body is made of rugged steel. However, it is partially melted in spots because of its own heat.

pokemon.name: 雷吉奇卡斯
descriptions: 据说它用各种各样的材料 制作了宝可梦后，把大陆 移动到了现在的位置。
在世上流传着的传说中， 它曾模仿自己的样子 创造出过宝可梦。

pokemon.name: 骑拉帝纳
descriptions: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.
It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.
This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.
A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

pokemon.name: 克雷色利亚
descriptions: Cresselia is reminiscent of the crescent moon. It leaves a brilliant line of light in its wake as it flies across the night sky. I daresay it resembles the heavenly maiden who created the Milky Way.
Those who sleep holding Cresselia’s feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully.

pokemon.name: 霏欧纳
descriptions: Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.
It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.
When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.
A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.

pokemon.name: 玛纳霏
descriptions: Rumored to migrate across the oceans and visit Hisui's coastal waters only rarely. Although Manaphy resembles Phione, it is also quite different. The relation between the two is unclear.
It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.
It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.
Water makes up 80% of its body. This Pokémon is easily affected by its environment.
Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

pokemon.name: 达克莱伊
descriptions: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.
It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.
To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.
Folklore has it that on moonless nights, this Pokémon will make people see horrific nightmares.

pokemon.name: 谢米
descriptions: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.
The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.
It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.
The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.
It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

pokemon.name: 阿尔宙斯
descriptions: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.
It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.
According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.
It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing then shaped the world.
It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.

pokemon.name: 比克提尼
descriptions: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.
This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

pokemon.name: 藤藤蛇
descriptions: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.
Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.
It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

pokemon.name: 青藤蛇
descriptions: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.
It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

pokemon.name: 君主蛇
descriptions: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.
It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior’s noble eyes.
They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

pokemon.name: 暖暖猪
descriptions: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.
It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

pokemon.name: 炒炒猪
descriptions: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.
Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

pokemon.name: 炎武王
descriptions: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.
It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.
A flaring beard of fire is proof that it is fired up. It is adept at using many different moves.

pokemon.name: 水水獭
descriptions: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.
It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.
The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just used for battle—it can be used to break open hard berries as well.
The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just used for battle--it can be used to break open hard berries as well.
The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

pokemon.name: 双刃丸
descriptions: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.
As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.
Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

pokemon.name: 大剑鬼
descriptions: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.
One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.
In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.
Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

pokemon.name: 探探鼠
descriptions: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.
Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.

pokemon.name: 步哨鼠
descriptions: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.
They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.

pokemon.name: 小约克
descriptions: 比普通的小孩子还要 聪明许多。对于得到的关爱 和受到的伤害都不会忘怀。
勇敢而慎重。 用覆盖着脸部的软毛 来获取周围的信息。
很聪明，会忠实地听从训练家的吩咐， 所以即便是新手也很容易培育。 是很受欢迎的宝可梦。
是拥有优秀判断力的宝可梦。 如果判断出自己无法战胜对手， 就会立即夹着尾巴逃走。
覆盖着脸部的毛拥有雷达的功能， 用来探索战斗对手的样子。

pokemon.name: 哈约克
descriptions: 覆盖在身上的黑色体毛 既厚又有弹性，甚至能 把尖锐的牙齿也反弹回去。
十分聪明，容易亲近。 也有人认为它是第一种 成为人类同伴的宝可梦。
与人类共同生活了很长时间， 久远到连古代的壁画上都 描绘着它的样子。
黑色的体毛会随着成长 而变得坚硬结实， 连爪子和牙齿也不能轻易穿透。
对主人的命令绝对服从。 但绝对不会听看起来 地位不如它的对手所说的话。

pokemon.name: 长毛狗
descriptions: 以自己气派的胡须为傲。 据说，每只个体在族群中的地位， 就是根据胡须长度来决定的。
似乎喜欢和人类一起生活。 就算是野生的长毛狗，捕捉后 只要过个三天就能和人亲近。
拥有又长又厚实的体毛。 过去在寒冷的地方， 每家都会养１只长毛狗。
多亏了那身又长又暖和的毛， 抵御寒冷根本不在话下。 阿罗拉的长毛狗看上去有点辛苦。
很聪明，且不用担心会朝人 猛扑过来，所以也有家长会 把保护孩子的任务交给它。

pokemon.name: 扒手猫
descriptions: 会用可爱的动作让对手放下戒心， 趁对方靠过来时冷不防地用爪子 猛抓，然后得意地大笑。
为了要看见人们困扰的样子 而去偷盗他们的物品。 和狡小狐是竞争对手。

pokemon.name: 酷豹
descriptions: 和猾大狐争抢地盘。 能够悄无声息地 从背后偷偷靠近猎物。
虽然人们容易被它美丽的 毛发和身姿所迷惑，但它其实 是一种善变而凶暴的宝可梦。

pokemon.name: 花椰猴
descriptions: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.
It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.
This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

pokemon.name: 花椰猿
descriptions: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.
It strikes its enemies with a thorn-covered tail. The leaf on its head is bitter.

pokemon.name: 爆香猴
descriptions: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.
Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.
This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600° F.
When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

pokemon.name: 爆香猿
descriptions: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.
A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.
It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

pokemon.name: 冷水猴
descriptions: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.
It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.

pokemon.name: 冷水猿
descriptions: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.
The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.
The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

pokemon.name: 食梦梦
descriptions: 在吃掉梦之后会吐出烟雾。 吃了快乐的梦时，烟雾是粉红色的； 如果是噩梦，烟雾则是黑灰色的。
会在深夜出现在枕头边。 在吃梦的时候， 身上的花纹会微微发亮。

pokemon.name: 梦梦蚀
descriptions: 总是在打瞌睡做梦。 刚睡醒的时候会闹脾气， 所以最好别去招惹它。
在它冒出黑黑的烟雾时， 还是不要接近它为妙， 否则噩梦将会成真。

pokemon.name: 豆豆鸽
descriptions: 虽然既健忘又不太聪明， 因为性格认真且容易亲近人， 所以受到了许多训练家的喜爱。
会出现在人类生活的地方。 一旦撒出饲料就会有好几百只 豆豆鸽聚集而来，千万要小心。

pokemon.name: 咕咕鸽
descriptions: 头脑聪明而且记性很好。 似乎有许多快递员 将它选为自己的搭档。
飞行速度不可小觑。 无论飞到多远的地方， 都会记得自己的主人和巢。

pokemon.name: 高傲雉鸡
descriptions: 头脑聪明，所以自尊心也强。 如果能成为高傲雉鸡的训练家， 所有人都会对你刮目相看。
拥有高度的飞行能力。 雌性擅于持久， 雄性擅长速度。

pokemon.name: 斑斑马
descriptions: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.
When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.
Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

pokemon.name: 雷电斑马
descriptions: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.
This ill-tempered Pokémon is dangerous because when it’s angry, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

pokemon.name: 石丸子
descriptions: 会对声音产生反应而动起来。 在能量核心的影响下， 它摸起来暖暖的。
几乎和铁一样硬， 但要是长时间浸在水里， 似乎就会稍微变软一些。
是从地裂的断层中被发现的。 构成身体的成分是好几百年前的土。
六角形的洞是它的耳朵。 耳朵里面有能量核心， 所以如果把手伸进去就会发怒。
在地下的最深处诞生。 会与亲缘相近的小拳石 和小碎钻较量硬度。

pokemon.name: 地幔岩
descriptions: 通过声音来探测四周。 要是惹它生气了，它会连 身体方向也不转就朝你追来。
橙色的结晶开始发光的时候， 一定特别小心，因为它 马上就会射出能量。
橙色的结晶是大大的能量块。 因为很有价值， 所以有时会被袭击。
从身体里溢出的能量 变成了橙色的结晶。 其硬度连钻石都能弄碎。
在洞窟里寻找地下水。 对水本身不是很适应， 所以都是一点点慢慢舔。

pokemon.name: 庞岩怪
descriptions: 它射出的能量弹具有 可以击飞翻斗车的破坏力。 不过只有在晴天才能射击。
由于拥有健壮的身体， 有时可以在工地或采石场看到它 和大王铜象还有人类一起工作。
吸收太阳的光线，射出能量。 平常都把身体藏在地底深处。
如果以全力射出能量， 那力量能让它自己的身体 骤然产生出无数裂缝。
因为拥有相当大的马力， 所以是深受建设相关人员喜爱， 被选作同伴的宝可梦。

pokemon.name: 滚滚蝙蝠
descriptions: 一边发出超音波，一边 飞来飞去寻找虫宝可梦 来填饱自己的肚子。
在洞窟中，如果抬头看到 墙壁上留着心形的痕迹， 就代表滚滚蝙蝠住在那里。

pokemon.name: 心蝙蝠
descriptions: 据说有些地区的人觉得 它鼻子的形状很吉利， 而把它当成幸福的象征来祭拜。
在发出极其强力的 音波后会陷入疲劳， 暂时无法飞行。

pokemon.name: 螺钉地鼠
descriptions: 会用爪子在地底挖掘前进。 一些农民因为担心它会 因此糟蹋蔬菜而讨厌它。
会将双掌上的爪子并拢， 并让身体高速旋转， 瞄准猎物冲过去。

pokemon.name: 龙头地鼠
descriptions: 别名钻头王。在地底下 挖掘前进的速度 达到了每小时１５０公里。
有许多看似自然形成的 洞窟其实都是龙头地鼠 一阵乱钻之后留下来的。

pokemon.name: 差不多娃娃
descriptions: 心地善良的宝可梦。 通过触角接触，就能了解 对方的心情和身体状况。
拥有敏锐的听觉。 连２公里以外小石头 滚动的声音都能听到。

pokemon.name: 搬运小匠
descriptions: 如果搬运小匠可以搬起 自己体重３倍左右的方材， 就代表它进化的日子要到了。
喜欢帮忙做建筑的工作。 因为下雨而停工时， 会乱挥木材大闹一番。

pokemon.name: 铁骨土人
descriptions: 能够灵巧地操纵工字钢。 虽然对拆除得心应手， 但却不太擅长组装。
与其他的伙伴还有豪力 一起比拼肌肉。输掉的 那一方会暂时躲起来。

pokemon.name: 修建老匠
descriptions: 要是认真起来就会 扔掉手中的混凝土柱， 赤手空拳地扑向敌人。
即使成分相同， 修建老匠搅拌的混凝土 格外地坚硬结实。

pokemon.name: 圆蝌蚪
descriptions: 通过音波来联系伙伴。 人类和其他宝可梦都 听不见它发出的警告声。
如果水面上扩散开美丽的 波纹，就代表有圆蝌蚪正在 水下面用高昂的声音鸣叫。

pokemon.name: 蓝蟾蜍
descriptions: 有时也会发出悦耳的叫声。 身上突起物越大的蓝蟾蜍 越能在更广的音域来鸣叫。
通过发出足以造成头痛的 音波来充分削弱猎物之后， 用黏糊糊的舌头将其捉住。

pokemon.name: 蟾蜍王
descriptions: 在老年人之间广受欢迎。 因为他们觉得它身上的瘤 发出的震动拿来按摩刚刚好。
通过震动全身的瘤， 引发地震般的晃动。 与不良蛙是相近的物种。

pokemon.name: 投摔鬼
descriptions: ５只一组一起努力练习。 在练习中掉队的投摔鬼 会扔掉带子离开团队。
能使出一流的投摔招式。 带子被战斗时流下的汗水 浸湿，颜色越变越深。

pokemon.name: 打击鬼
descriptions: 不断重复练习的打击鬼 所使出的空手劈拥有 足以劈开大海的破坏力。
不断地寻求强大的实力。 要是看到了在山上修行的 打击鬼，就静静地离开吧。

pokemon.name: 虫宝包
descriptions: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.
This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.
Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

pokemon.name: 宝包茧
descriptions: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.
Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
Preferring dark, damp places, it spends the entire day eating fallen leaves that lie around it.

pokemon.name: 保姆虫
descriptions: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.
Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.
Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

pokemon.name: 百足蜈蚣
descriptions: 牙齿上有剧毒。一旦 发现看上去能吃的猎物， 就会不假思索地扑上去。
虽然与烧火蚣是种类 相近的伙伴，但是 一见面就会大打一番。

pokemon.name: 车轮球
descriptions: 用坚硬的壳和带毒的刺 保护自己的身体， 积蓄进化所需的能量。
高速旋转突击对方。 最高时速可以达到 １００公里左右。

pokemon.name: 蜈蚣王
descriptions: 会和焚焰蚣激烈地争夺 领地。输掉的那一方 会成为另一方的猎物。
用颈部的爪子抓住猎物后， 会直接将对方摔向地面， 然后将带毒的尖刺猛戳进去。

pokemon.name: 木棉球
descriptions: 将木棉球和白蓬蓬的棉花 混合后编织出的布料极其精致， 因此常被高级品牌选用。
会喷出棉花保护身体。 有时会被台风吹到 地球的另一边。
一旦被袭击，就会喷出 身上的棉花来代替自己的身体。 喷出的棉花很快又会长出来。
会喷出棉花保护身体。 如果淋到雨，棉花就会受潮变重， 身体变得动弹不得。
使用木棉球吐出的棉花 制作而成的枕头和被褥 是又轻又透气的高级商品。

pokemon.name: 风妖精
descriptions: 每当沐浴阳光，身上的棉花 就会膨胀。如果膨胀过了头， 它就会把棉花扯开到处乱撒。
喜欢到处撒棉花捣蛋。 沾水之后就会变重而 动弹不得，只能听天由命。
并没有特定的栖息地。 乘着旋风到处现身，搞恶作剧。
潜入民居，藏起重要的东西， 或是在屋子里到处撒棉花， 是个捣蛋的家伙。
乘着风出现， 但如果风力过强， 头上的棉花就会被风扯掉。

pokemon.name: 百合根娃娃
descriptions: 叶子的颜色越深就越健康。 有时也会在被精心照料过的 田地或花坛里定居下来。
会出现在清澈的水边。 用它头上的叶子煮出的汤 有时会被作为驱虫剂使用。
很喜欢干净的水和土壤。 如果栖息地的环境变差， 就会群体迁移到新的地方去。
如果利用阳光晒干它头上的叶子， 再煎煮后饮用，会马上变得有活力， 在老年人中很受欢迎。
如果时不时修剪叶子， 就会长成圆鼓鼓很华丽的样子。

pokemon.name: 裙儿小姐
descriptions: 用它的花朵制成的精油 虽有着极致香气，但价格 同时也贵得令人大跌眼镜。
据说即使对一流的园艺家 来说，让它头上的花朵绽放 也是一件极其困难的事。
因为美丽而受其他宝可梦喜爱。 头上的花如果疏于照料， 很快就会腐烂枯萎。
根据栽培土壤的成分不同， 花香也会略微不一样。 闻一下就能治愈心灵，心情舒畅。
一旦找到了♂作为同伴， 美丽的花就会渐渐黯淡， 变得枯萎。

pokemon.name: 野蛮鲈鱼
descriptions: 从前也曾经登上餐桌。 红条纹野蛮鲈鱼的肉脂肪含量高， 适合年轻人食用。
它上钩时顽强的抵抗深受垂钓者 的喜爱。由于人们擅自把它们 放生到池塘里，数量越来越多。
因为性格粗暴，在野蛮鲈鱼群 出现的湖里，就只有龙虾小兵 和铁螯龙虾之类的能留下来。
是性格粗暴又凶猛的宝可梦。 红色和蓝色的野蛮鲈鱼 总是为了领地问题打架。

pokemon.name: 黑眼鳄
descriptions: 个头虽小，腰腿却很有力。 会拨开沙子，在沙漠里 犹如游泳般地自在移动。
沙漠到了夜里会比较冷， 因此它会潜伏到沙子深处， 睡到太阳出来为止。
因为还不太擅长狩猎， 所以主要是吃倒毙在沙漠里的东西。 被称为沙漠的清扫者。
对它来说，全年温暖的阿罗拉 是很容易生活的环境。 即使在沙漠以外也时常能见到。
把身体潜藏在沙子中， 一口吃掉在上面行走的猎物的脚。 最喜欢吃的东西是大颚蚁。

pokemon.name: 混混鳄
descriptions: 虽然拥有能在黑暗中看清事物的 特殊双眼，但由于沙漠的夜晚寒冷， 所以一般不怎么活动。
多亏了那双能在黑暗中看清 四周的特殊眼睛，即使在深夜里 它也能精准地进行捕猎。
把猎物的一部分埋在沙子里， 作为狩猎失败时的储备粮。
非常害怕身体变冷。 在气温下降的夜晚 会潜藏在沙漠的沙子深处。
多亏了盖住眼睛的特殊膜， 即使在深夜也能把周围 看得一清二楚。

pokemon.name: 流氓鳄
descriptions: 虽然凶暴，但也有擅长忍耐的一面。 为了捕获猎物，可以在 沙子里静静等上好几天。
被称为沙之恶霸。 就连厚厚的铁板也能 用强力的颚轻松咬断。
把身体藏在沙漠蜻蜓引起的沙暴中， 静静地等待着猎物的到来。
如果发现前方５０公里处的猎物， 就会像游泳一样在沙漠里移动， 扑过去咬住。
用强力的颚咬住后， 就这么拼命扭转身体， 将猎物切断。

pokemon.name: 火红不倒翁
descriptions: 在它睡觉的时候， 无论是推是拉，它都不会倒下。 因为象征着吉利而大受欢迎。
能量之源是体内的火焰。 如果火焰变小了， 它马上就会睡着。

pokemon.name: 达摩狒狒
descriptions: 体内的火焰燃得越旺， 力量就越大。火焰的温度 有时甚至能超过１４００度。
总是热血沸腾的宝可梦。 它厚重的手臂使出的拳击 甚至能把翻斗车打得粉碎。

pokemon.name: 沙铃仙人掌
descriptions: 一年散播一次种子。 花的种子营养十足， 是沙漠中贵重的食粮。
会发出沙铃般的声音。 鸟宝可梦会因那轻快的 节奏而受惊飞走。

pokemon.name: 石居蟹
descriptions: 如果找不到大小合适 的石头来当成自己的家， 它也会住到河马兽的洞里。
会在自己喜欢的石头上开洞 当成住所。对石丸子还有 小炭仔来说是天敌。

pokemon.name: 岩殿居蟹
descriptions: 厚实的钳子是它最大的武器。 硬度高到甚至能让 超甲狂犀的护具裂开。
喜欢干燥的地方， 下雨时不会从岩石里出来。 有着很强的地盘意识。

pokemon.name: 滑滑小子
descriptions: 用结实的皮保护身体。 据说在皮伸展到极限时， 它就会开始进化。
与它视线交汇是很危险的！ 不管对手是谁，它都会用 头锤招呼，是个难搞的家伙。
会把松垮垮的皮使劲 向上拉到脖子用来保护自己。 好像皮拉得越厉害的个体，地位越高。
几只为一组行动。 漫无目的地到处走，会冷不丁地 向视线相遇的对手施以头锤。

pokemon.name: 头巾混混
descriptions: 虽然性格非常粗鲁， 但也有重视家族、 伙伴和领地的另一面。
它看似无精打采的踢击 其实拥有足以击碎修建老匠 手中混凝土的破坏力。
吐出唾沫挑衅对手。 有着固定的领地， 会在那儿度过一生，永不离开。
性格粗鲁，但是对于自己的家族、 群体的伙伴和领地，非常重视。

pokemon.name: 象征鸟
descriptions: 人们在象征鸟飞过的沙漠 的地下调查，结果在那里 发现了疑似古代都市的遗迹。
利用精神力量在空中飞翔， 被称为古代都市的守护神。 也有人认为它是守护神的使者。

pokemon.name: 哭哭面具
descriptions: 古代人的灵魂变成了宝可梦。 为了寻找认得自己长相的人 而在遗迹里徘徊。
每天夜里都在遗迹中徘徊。 据说它拿着的面具 是它还是人类时的脸。

pokemon.name: 迭失棺
descriptions: 迭失棺象征着国王的财富， 因此许多古墓里 都有它的壁画。
拥有闪亮亮的黄金之躯。 据说它已再也无法记起 自己曾是人类。

pokemon.name: 原盖海龟
descriptions: 由化石复活的宝可梦。 人们认为它是很多 龟宝可梦的祖先。
曾经栖息于古代的海洋。 虽然只会爬着走，但为了 寻找猎物也会到陆地上来。
从１０００米深的深海到陆地， 这样广阔的范围曾经都是它的狩猎场。
由古代的化石复活而来。 曾生活在海里， 但也会到陆地上来寻找猎物。
据说是大部分龟宝可梦的祖先。 曾经生活在大约１亿年前的 温暖大海里。

pokemon.name: 肋骨海龟
descriptions: 虽然和在水中相比动作 会变得迟缓，但是为了寻找 猎物也会登上陆地活动。
连猎物的壳和骨头也都会 干干净净地吃得一丝不剩， 所以甲壳成长得又厚又坚硬。
为了让坚硬的甲壳更为结实， 会把捕捉到的猎物吃到 连壳和骨头都不剩。
颚部的力量非常惊人。 连多刺菊石兽和菊石兽的壳 也能轻轻松松地整个吃掉。
在大海和陆地两个地方活动。 将陆地的猎物拖入海中后杀死。

pokemon.name: 始祖小鸟
descriptions: 被称为鸟宝可梦的祖先。 栖息在树上，以树果和 虫宝可梦为食。
从化石中成功复原。 正如研究所说，它虽然不会飞， 但却是擅长跳跃的宝可梦。
从化石复原而来。 有翅膀，但还不会飞。 是古代的鸟宝可梦。
被认为是所有鸟宝可梦的祖先， 但最近的研究里也有说法 认为这个是错误的。
似乎不会飞行， 但听说会从高高的树上 滑翔捕捉猎物。

pokemon.name: 始祖大鸟
descriptions: 虽然也会飞行， 但是似乎更擅长在 地面上捕捉猎物。
会为了飞翔而助跑。 助跑的距离大约为４公里， 跑步的速度为每小时４０公里。
据说是鸟宝可梦的祖先。 挥动翅膀的肌肉还很弱， 必须助跑才能飞起来。
古代的宝可梦。 因为羽毛很细，所以如果不是 熟练的匠人，就会复原失败。
成群结队进行捕猎。 将猎物追到无路可逃时， 其他伙伴就会从空中发动突袭。

pokemon.name: 破破袋
descriptions: 诞生于塞满垃圾的垃圾袋里。 它嘴里喷出的毒气 是伽勒尔双弹瓦斯的最爱。
喜欢不卫生的地方。 如果不及时清理家里的垃圾， 破破袋就会过来居住。
像打嗝一样吐出的瓦斯， 一旦被小孩子吸入， 就会有性命攸关的危险。
呼吸的时候会有毒瓦斯漏出。 臭臭泥闻到气味就会流着口水赶过来。
吃垃圾吃到肚子鼓鼓之后， 从嘴里喷出毒瓦斯来。 不小心闻到的话要立即进医院。

pokemon.name: 灰尘山
descriptions: 从右臂喷出的毒液十分危险， 虚弱的生物只要一沾到， 立刻就会丢掉性命。
吃掉的垃圾会在体内 转化为毒素。毒素的成分 会随着吃掉的垃圾而不同。
阿罗拉的灰尘山有点儿魁梧， 据说是因为有臭臭泥这个天敌的缘故。
用左臂锁住敌人后， 会将有毒的液体泼向对方全身， 封住其行动。
某个时期在阿罗拉呈爆发式增长， 但是臭泥来了之后， 数量一下子减少了。

pokemon.name: 索罗亚
descriptions: 为了寻找食物，有时甚至会 幻化成人类出现在城镇里。 多数情况下会幻化成小孩。
之所以学会了幻化成 其他东西的能力，似乎是 因为它的性格比较胆小。
平时很爱说话的孩子 如果突然不说话了， 或许是被索罗亚替换了哦。
性格胆小的宝可梦， 不和伙伴呆在一起的时候， 通常都会幻化成其他东西。

pokemon.name: 索罗亚克
descriptions: 孤独的训练家会命令 索罗亚克为自己展现幻像， 借以排遣孤身一人的寂寞。
时刻为伙伴着想的宝可梦。 为保护自己的栖息地和族群， 会让敌人看到恐怖的幻象。
据说，栖息地快要暴露在人类面前时， 它就会制造出幻象， 让人在森林里不断徘徊。
不只是幻化成其他东西， 还拥有让几百人看见幻像的力量。

pokemon.name: 泡沫栗鼠
descriptions: 用尾巴互相抚摸来打招呼。 尾巴的毛比较蓬松的那一方 会表现得稍微威风些。
用尾巴来清扫灰尘。 虽说能帮忙打扫是件好事， 它的洁癖也会让人感到棘手。
因为清洁自己的身体和巢穴 而弄脏的尾巴，会花上１天的时间 用涌出的干净泉水清洗。
因为有洁癖，所以不能容忍 一丁点儿的脏污。会把尾巴 当做拖把彻底地清除脏污。

pokemon.name: 奇诺栗鼠
descriptions: 覆盖着特别油脂的毛发 可以挡住攻击。这种油 以高价在市场上流通。
洁癖使它连一丝灰尘都 无法容忍，会把自己身上 渗出的油涂在巢上保持清洁。
从全身渗出的油非常滑。 对于因肌肤干燥而烦恼的人 也很有效果。
白色的毛发上涂满身体里渗出的油， 连敌人的攻击也能滑溜溜地避开。

pokemon.name: 哥德宝宝
descriptions: 哥德宝宝会在看似无人的地方 轻声地叫。它好像是在与某种 只有它才看得见的东西说话。
虽然还是宝宝，有时也会 用储存在像蝴蝶结一样的 触角里的精神力量来战斗。

pokemon.name: 哥德小童
descriptions: 哥德小童的精神力量似乎会 在星光闪耀的夜晚达到最高点。 它与宇宙的关系至今不明。
据说会在星光闪耀的夜晚 把睡着的孩子们带走。 也有人称它为惩罚魔女。

pokemon.name: 哥德小姐
descriptions: 从哥德小姐那里 看到了自己下场的恶人 在那之后便销声匿迹了。
根据星星的动向预知未来。 虽然拥有强大的精神力量， 但生性并不喜好纷争。

pokemon.name: 单卵细胞球
descriptions: 身体被特殊的液体包裹着， 许多人因此认为它 即使在宇宙中也能存活。
通过心灵感应来与伙伴交流。 如果受到了强烈的冲击， 包裹着身体的液体就会漏出来。

pokemon.name: 双卵细胞球
descriptions: 由于它一分为二的大脑 思考的内容几乎完全不同， 导致它的行动非常难以预测。
据称说它的２个大脑 意见一致时，发出的念力 可以覆盖方圆１公里的范围。

pokemon.name: 人造细胞卵
descriptions: 虽然有人说只要喝掉它特殊的液体 就能得到智慧，但对人造细胞卵 以外来说，那其实是剧毒。
比起使用超能力， 它更喜欢靠着挥动 自傲的手臂来打倒对手。

pokemon.name: 鸭宝宝
descriptions: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.
When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.
These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.

pokemon.name: 舞天鹅
descriptions: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.
It administers sharp, powerful pecks with its bill. It whips its long neck to deliver forceful repeated strikes.

pokemon.name: 迷你冰
descriptions: 据说它是从冰柱中诞生的。 为了能让自己生活得更舒适， 会吐出零下５０度的冷气冻住四周。
无法在炎热的地方生存。 会吐出冷气来降雪， 然后窝在积雪里睡觉。
是由沐浴在朝阳下但仍不愿 融化的冰柱诞生而成。 晚上会潜入雪中睡觉。
会吐出零下５０度的冷气。 如果呆在温暖的场所， 就会一点点地变小。
抱紧的话，就会感觉凉凉的 非常舒服。在炎热地区， 是每家必备１只的便利宝可梦。

pokemon.name: 多多冰
descriptions: 性格和善，虽然会用 零下１００度的冷气冻住敌人， 但并不会伤及它们的性命。
通过喝下干净的水 来让自己的冰雪身躯成长。 天气好的时候很少看到它。
从冰河时期生存下来， 非常魁梧的宝可梦。 特别是在炎热的地方，极受欢迎。
喷出冰粒，冻住敌人的身体。 阿罗拉的多多冰整体都是小型的。
从冰河时期就已经存在了。 操纵冰粒让敌人冻住后， 用头锤将对方打碎。

pokemon.name: 双倍多多冰
descriptions: 体温在零下６度左右。 据说是由２只多多冰 贴在一起而诞生的。
当愤怒达到极限时， 就会喷出暴风雪， 把敌人和伙伴都冻成冰块。
因朝阳而开始融化的 ２只多多冰贴在一起， 在寒冷的夜里再次冻结时诞生而成。
从２张嘴里喷出暴风雪。 无论在哪里都能制作出雪来， 所以很受滑雪和滑雪板爱好者欢迎。
即使失去了一侧的头也不会 有什么问题，能继续活着。 在身体的内部制造雪云。

pokemon.name: 四季鹿
descriptions: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.
Their coloring changes according to the seasons and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.
The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

pokemon.name: 萌芽鹿
descriptions: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.
They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.

pokemon.name: 电飞鼠
descriptions: 最喜欢甜甜的树果。有时也会 因为在脸颊的袋子里囤了太多 食物而无法好好飞行。
一边放电一边如舞蹈般 在空中飞翔。虽然很可爱， 但是很难对付。
一边到处放电一边飞翔， 因此鸟宝可梦们都不会靠近。 得益于此，可以独占食物。
蓄着电在空中飞行。 有时甚至会在雷鸣的深夜里， 密密麻麻布满整个天空。
用电击将树果和虫宝可梦 烧得刚刚好后再吃掉。 以小笃儿啄空的树洞为主要巢穴。

pokemon.name: 盖盖虫
descriptions: 用嘴里吐出的液体 来溶化小嘴蜗的壳， 只会去吃里面的身体。
有着会对电能产生反应的 奇异体质。和小嘴蜗 待在一起就会进化。

pokemon.name: 骑士蜗牛
descriptions: 会举起长矛突击敌人。 有一幅名画描绘着 它和葱游兵决斗的场景。
抢走小嘴蜗的壳，将自己 全副武装。在伽勒尔地区， 骑士蜗牛非常受到人们喜爱。

pokemon.name: 哎呀球菇
descriptions: 从双手喷出的孢子虽然 含有剧毒，但据说彻底干燥后 可以用作治疗肠胃的药。
关于它酷似精灵球的 花纹的意义和理由， 至今都无人知晓。

pokemon.name: 败露球菇
descriptions: 平常一般不太动。 只是一动不动地待在 掉落于地面的精灵球旁边。
会喷出带毒的孢子。 如果不马上把它洗掉， 那里就会长出蘑菇来哦。

pokemon.name: 轻飘飘
descriptions: 据流传至今的传说里所述， 它是由沉没到海底的古代都市 的居民变成的宝可梦。
会用薄纱般的手脚 缠住猎物，将对手拖进 ８０００米深的海中。
为了麻痹敌人，让其溺毙， 薄纱般的手脚上有许多 肉眼无法看到的毒针。
会用薄纱般的手脚缠住 正在游泳的猎物， 将其拖入深海之中。

pokemon.name: 胖嘟嘟
descriptions: 每到满月时，胖嘟嘟会 成群结队地来到海面上。 这么做是为了等待猎物上门。
身体的绝大部分都由 与海水相同的成分组成。 会把沉船当成自己的城堡。
它是令渔夫恐惧的存在。 传说，它会将渔夫拖入海中， 夺走对方的性命。
会缠着豪华客轮或是油轮周围， 目的是将猎物拖进海里。

pokemon.name: 保姆曼波
descriptions: 之所以会救助体弱的宝可梦， 好像是因为盯上它们的 宝可梦也会攻击它自己。
渔夫在长距离航海时会带着它。 因为有了保姆曼波， 医生和药都不需要了。
漂浮在汪洋大海上生活。 保姆曼波的周围 会聚集起许多水属性宝可梦。
抱着受伤的宝可梦， 用特殊的粘液敷伤口。 但其中的理由不太清楚。

pokemon.name: 电电虫
descriptions: 会附在其他宝可梦身上 吸取静电。经常会把自己 贴在来电汪的屁股上。
会附在宝可梦的身上 吸取静电。自身并没有 制造电的能力。

pokemon.name: 电蜘蛛
descriptions: 为了捕捉不太会飞的幼鸟， 会在鸟宝可梦的巢穴附近 用带电的丝设下陷阱。
发射腹部带电的毛来攻击。 要是被它的毛刺中， 就会全身麻痹三天三夜。

pokemon.name: 种子铁球
descriptions: 偏爱长着青苔的洞窟。 青苔中所含的酶能使它的 尖刺成长得又大又结实。
会发射尖刺来保护自己。 需要反复训练才能将 尖刺准确地射中目标。

pokemon.name: 坚果哑铃
descriptions: 拥有比钢铁还坚硬的尖刺。 会利用触手上的尖刺 攀附在岩壁上移动。
用尖刺刺裂岩壁之后， 它会用触手的尖端 接触裂缝吸收营养。

pokemon.name: 齿轮儿
descriptions: ２个身体比双胞胎还要亲近。 要是换成别的齿轮儿。 就没有办法好好咬合。
据说在很久以前， 是看到了齿轮儿的人 发明了齿轮的构造。

pokemon.name: 齿轮组
descriptions: 被认为是工业技术的象征。 有许多伽勒尔当地的公司 选择它作为企业的标志。
如果认真起来，大齿轮外圈的 齿轮会和小齿轮完全接合。 此时转速将会大幅提升。

pokemon.name: 齿轮怪
descriptions: 让３个齿轮高速旋转。 新增出来的那个带着 尖刺的齿轮并不是生物。
会从尖刺的前端发出强力 电击。红色核心里填充着 非常多的能量。

pokemon.name: 麻麻小鱼
descriptions: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.
While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
